messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm starting initial bring-up for a new model on dev-staging: `mistral-mini-v2` (optimize for latency/cost). Can folks eyeball a short smoke checklist?

jonah: sounds good. list out what you want checked, I can run perf/quant runs later today. :thumbsup:

maya: basic checklist I'm thinking: load check, small forward pass, simple instruction following, arithmetic sanity, summarization, deterministic inference check, and a quick quantization compare (fp16 vs int8). Also confirm tokenization matches our pipeline.

liwei: add a curl-level API smoke too — make sure streaming works and no truncation. I can do that.

sam: I'll monitor p50/p95/p99 and memory. Quick note: if you try int4, watch for tokenization drift and occasional bad completions — int8 is usually safer for first pass.

maya: cool. TL;DR commands I'm using:

```
python infra/smoke_runner.py --model-path /models/mistral-mini-v2 --mode forward --batch 1 --seq-len 128
python eval/smoke_prompts.py --prompts smoke_prompts.jsonl --model /models/mistral-mini-v2 --quantize fp16
python eval/smoke_prompts.py --prompts smoke_prompts.jsonl --model /models/mistral-mini-v2 --quantize int8
```

jonah: ran fp16 quick pass: load ok, single 128-token forward ~115ms p50 on a T4-ish dev node, mem peak ~3.6GB. No OOMs.

liwei: streaming API check: ok for short outputs, but for one summarization prompt we saw truncation at 512 tokens — likely default response cap. maya: do you have cap param?

maya: yes, I used `max_tokens=512`. Can increase to 1024 and re-run.

sam: int8 smoke: lowered mem to ~2.1GB, forward ~95ms p50, but one phrasing test failed — model omitted named entities in a summarization Q (compare outputs). Saving examples to s3://redwood-dev/evals/mistral-mini-v2/int8-smoke/ for review.

maya: thanks. can you paste a failing example?

sam: example (truncated):
- prompt: "Summarize the article about Dr. Amina Hussein and her vaccine work."
- fp16: "Dr. Amina Hussein led a vaccine trial showing 80% efficacy..."
- int8: "The article discussed recent vaccine trials and public health implications."

liwei: smells like quantization-induced token preference shift. We should run n=10 seeds on that prompt and compare token-level divergence.

jonah: I'll run jit/kv-cache correctness test too — send me the exact commit/model artifact.

infra-bot: staging deploy completed for commit `a3f9d2b` -> cluster dev-staging. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/mistral-mini-v2/a3f9d2b.tar.gz

maya: linking eval harness run: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/7891 (fp16) and https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/7892 (int8).

eval-bot: smoke suite summary: 12 prompts run; instruction-following pass 11/12 (fp16), 9/12 (int8). Arithmetic exact match 6/6 both. Tokenization diffs: 0/12.

sam: recommendation: keep int8 for memory/perf but flag the two fail prompts for later calibration or prefer fp16 for customer-facing rollout until we understand regressions.

maya: agreed. Action items:
- sam: collect failing prompts + token diffs and upload to s3 (assigned)
- jonah: run kv-cache/jit validation and larger batch throughput test (assigned)
- liwei: re-run API streaming with `max_tokens=1024` and check for any new truncation issues (assigned)
- maya: iterate on quantization recipe (try symmetric vs affine) and re-run int8 smoke

sam: done — uploading now. s3://redwood-dev/evals/mistral-mini-v2/int8-smoke/fail_examples.jsonl

jonah: started kv-cache test. quick note: one non-deterministic token mismatch at step 78 on fp16 (investigating).

liwei: streaming re-run with 1024 looks good, no truncation and no additional errors. p99 latency rose ~40ms for the longer streams.

maya: excellent. I'll hold off on promoting this model to dedicated until we resolve the int8 regression. For prioritization: this is medium priority — perf gains are attractive but correctness first.

jonah: agreed. If sam can reduce regressions with calibration we can revisit.

maya: thanks all. I'll consolidate notes into a short onboarding card in the model registry and ping here when ready for a next pass. :purple_heart:
